name: Naraka
description: Naraka was a rocky and hazy planet located in the Outer Rim Territories. During the Imperial Era, it was controlled by the Galactic Empire, who maintained a prison there. In 2 BBY, the rebel team known as the Spectres traveled to Naraka to rescue the pirate Hondo Ohnaka from the prison.
